title: Iki trigger (iki/v1)
description: Runs one of the plugin's actions by itself when an entity of a type is created or changed. It runs in a project only after the project's Admins turn it on, and runs as the Admin who did.

name.description: The trigger's name in snake_case. Elsewhere it is `plugin.name`.

on.description: What fires it: an entity of its type created (`entity.created`), or changed (`entity.updated`). Changes a triggered run makes never fire a trigger.

type.description: The entities it fires for, with their subtypes.

fields.description: For `entity.updated`: it fires only when one of these fields changed. Without them, any change fires it.

run.description: The name of the plugin's action it runs, on the entity. It can't be one that runs on the client tier: nobody is at their computer for it.

input.description: The action's input that takes the entity. It can be left out when only one input takes the trigger's type.

params.description: The action's params, by name. A string starting with `$` is written `$$`. Those left out take their defaults.
